text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is a day off, but I don't really have anything to do.
Just as I was thinking of killing time with some work...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer!
Just in time... wait.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ?? Why are you holding documents?
choice_data_list: Huh? I had some free time, so I thought I'd get some work done...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today is a day off! And it's Christmas, you know?
C-H-R-I-S-T-M-A-S!!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm free until tonight too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm not letting you off on your own until night, Trainer!
We're gonna play together! Okay?"
choice_data_list: Um... well then, maybe I'll do that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was overwhelmed by how seriously she took Christmas,
but I ended up going along with her anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Delicious!
My cheeks melted clean off for about 5 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "When you think of Christmas markets, you've gotta have whipped hot cocoa~♪"
choice_data_list: Christmas food really lifts your spirits, doesn't it?
Christmas treats really get you in the spirit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Then next is... that!
The spiral swirl sausage!
choice_data_list: Great! The calorie count won't affect the race either.
Sounds good! It's not enough calories to affect your race anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Geez, your work persona is showing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
When you think of Christmas, you think of amusement parks!
What should I go on first, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: "Who will be the Santa that wins the crowd's cheers!? The Santa Race!" Registration is now open!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Deafening cheers! The race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, Trainer!
choice_data_list: No choice but to do it!
Guess I have no choice but to do it!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Santas run and run!
Howeeever! Waiting in ambush is—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Th-this isn't just not a race,
I can't even run at all~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A course along a road blanketed in deep snow.
The other runners seem to be walking through it, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her athletic ability...
the "road" isn't the only thing we can use!
choice_data_list: Gran, look up!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! ...Aha, that's my Trainer for you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm Santa, after all!
I might as well just run across the "sky"♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Jingle♪ Jingle♪ Jiiiingle♪♪

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What?! Leaping from tree to tree?!
She's cleared the snowy course in one fell swoop!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: N-No waaaay!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays, good Trainer-san!
...I heard your cheers loud and clear♪
choice_data_list: Nice going, Gran!
You did it, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place is Santa Gran Alegria!!
Santa of Santas, this roar of cheers belongs to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaahhh!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
Trainer, it looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Snowman VS Sumo Wrestler Sweater!
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was such a unique sweater
that I was a bit hesitant about whether I should be happy or not..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Which one should I go with?
Last year was that giant Santa-face sweater, so—"
choice_data_list: You buy a sweater like this every year!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! I always go all out for Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Both my mom and dad are total workaholics.
They're out late, and sometimes I don't even see them on weekends.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Stormy nights used to scare me so much... I'd cuddle up
tight with my siblings to fall asleep.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, Christmas was different!
They made sure to finish all their work and come home for me.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: At night, we all gather around some chicken!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why Christmas is a major family event!
Our motto is to enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And so, ugly sweaters are the dress code
for Christmas in our house♪
choice_data_list: I see, Christmas is an important day to you.
Christmas is an important day to you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
After all, it's an important day to spend with the people who mean the most to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This sweater has warmed even my heart.
It's a good opportunity, so maybe I'll buy it. And also—"
choice_data_list: Let's find a design you'll be happy with!
Let's find a design you'll be happy with!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehe, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For her, who spent this important day together with me.
Is there... something I can give her?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's already evening, huh?! I'd love to go see
the light illuminations, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: We should be heading to your parents' place soon, shouldn't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had been a day of enjoying Christmas to the absolute fullest.
However, it seems things are finally coming to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spend Christmas night with cherished family.
That is her own cherished rule.
choice_data_list: I'm heading home, then. See you tomorrow!
I'm heading home, then. See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Didn't I tell you?
Christmas is a day to spend with someone special~.
choice_data_list: You did say that, didn't you...?
You did say that, didn't you...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
How many miles did you walk today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surprised by Gran Alegria's question, I check the pedometer on my smartphone.
choice_data_list: ...Around 5 miles?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
However, it's not just any "5 miles".

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
About the race.
I find myself constantly thinking about my dream.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because you believed in my strength,
in my victory, more than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, you made this important day of mine
feel truly special."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today's 5 miles are packed with those memories—
packed with everything 'precious' to me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
For miles and miles to come.
The one I want to walk alongside forever is you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
See? If a Trainer like that
wasn't someone special to me, then...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I don't know what's truly important!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I've faced her earnestly as her Trainer. To think she cares this much about me in return...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!!
Wait, if you actually had something to do, I'm sorry!"
choice_data_list: No! ...Wait, is your family going to be okay with this?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I already contacted Mom yesterday!
That's why this morning, I went to invite Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Trainer-san!
Just in time... wait,"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe.
I forgot to invite you!"

text_block_list.name: Gran's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, you have to see this toddler race video too!
The smile after crossing the finish line is just so adorable.
choice_data_list: Yes! I'll use this for my training!

text_block_list.name: Gran's Father
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's show them the aquarium one too!
The part where she cries at the deep-sea fish is so cute.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Papa, that's not what this is about~
choice_data_list: The more information we have, the better...
The more information the better, huh……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Gran's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please continue to take good care
of her from now on.
choice_data_list: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What I can give to her, who spent this important day with me...
is to make her dream come true."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, it turned out to be a Christmas full of motivation!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Are you sure seeing me off only this far is enough?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because it's a familiar road.
Yeah, because it's a familiar road.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Please be careful on your way home!
And also—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, good Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Actually, me too...
Actually, me too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was something I found while looking for a sweater.
The moment I laid eyes on it, I knew it had to be this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To her, who spent this important day with me,
I felt that I wanted to give something."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
! The same wrapping!
Could the contents be—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A pedometer that measures in miles??
choice_data_list: Who would have thought we'd pick the exact same one?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—...Fufu, ufufu!
To think something like this could happen!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Matching pedometers.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Our Mile.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Trainer, you really are amazing after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've come to love Christmas
even more now!
